# A Line Under a Name

*A wool buyer Swithin wrote going out to the downs a year ago never came back through the gate. Find the milestone at Downs Edge she would have passed, clear 30 wild bees there, and tell Brann what you found.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Swithin](../npcs/swithin.md) |
| Level | 23 |
| Leads to | [The Margin Guess](../quests/swithin_the_margin_guess.md) |

## Objectives

1. Look at the old milestone in [Downs Edge](../maps/downs_edge.md)
2. Defeat 30 [Wild Bee](../monsters/wild_bee.md) in [Downs Edge](../maps/downs_edge.md)
3. Talk to [Brann](../npcs/brann.md)

## Rewards

- 3,000 EXP
- 460 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- +20 standing with Selsior
- +100 standing with [Swithin](../npcs/swithin.md)
